```{r}
pacman::p_load(tidyverse, bayesplot, tidybayes, cmdstanr)
source("functions.R")
```


```{r}
#load in the patient and print summary of fitted parameters
patient_id = 04

target_dir = here::here("fits/free_rs_K_first_cycle")
fit_path <- make_fit_path(patient_id = patient_id, dir = target_dir)
fit <- readRDS(fit_path)

#show the summary
fit$summary() 

fit$diagnostic_summary()



```

```{r}
pars <- c("cost", "turnover", "n0", "rFrac", "K", "rS", "sigma")
np   <- nuts_params(fit)          # divergences, treedepth, energy per iteration

# trace plots, divergent iterations marked as red ticks under each panel
mcmc_parcoord(fit$draws(pars), np = np)

```
